title: A Hard-Label Black-Box Evasion Attack against ML-based Malicious Traffic Detection Systems (NetMasquerade)
authors: Zixuan Liu; Yi Zhao; Zhuotao Liu; Qi Li; Chuanpu Fu; Guangmeng Zhou; Ke Xu
notes: Identity confirmed on PDF title page and Crossref (DOI 10.14722/ndss.2026.230916). System name NetMasquerade appears in abstract; official title does not contain it. RL + Traffic-BERT hard-label traffic-space evasion; evades certified BARS. Appendix IX referenced. Also arXiv 2510.14906.

title: Robustifying ML-powered Network Classifiers with PANTS
notes: Confirmed on USENIX proceedings PDF title page. Realizable (SMT-constrained) adversarial samples + adversarial training for network classifiers; appendices B and D referenced.

title: "What is the Problem Space?" Defining Host-space Adversarial Perturbations against Network Intrusion Detection Systems
authors: Miel Verkerken; Laurens D'hooge; Bruno Volckaert; Filip De Turck; Giovanni Apruzzese
venue: ACM Asia Conference on Computer and Communications Security (ASIA CCS '26)
notes: arXiv version (2605.25822v1); check equivalence with published version. Crossref lists ASIA CCS 2026 proceedings DOI 10.1145/3779208.3807482; PDF footer shows ASIA CCS '26, June 1-5 2026, Bangalore. Host-space perturbations (tool/command changes) evade CICIDS-trained NIDS. Has appendices.

title: PCAP-Backdoor: Backdoor Generator in Network Traffic for Intrusion Detection Systems
authors: Ajesh Koyatan Chathoth; Parashar (given name UNVERIFIED); Peng (given name UNVERIFIED); Stephen Lee
notes: arXiv version; check equivalence with published version. arXiv 2501.15563 v2 title 'PCAP-Backdoor: Backdoor Poisoning Generator for Network Traffic in CPS/IoT Environments' with authors Ajesh Koyatan Chathoth, Stephen Lee only. Crossref (DOI 10.1145/3805033, published 2026-05-12) gives the retitled ACM TCPS journal version with 4 authors (Chathoth, Parashar, Peng, Lee); given names of middle authors not confirmed. PCAP-level trigger insertion before feature extraction, ~1-2% poisoning.

title: Constrained Network Adversarial Attacks: Validity, Robustness, and Transferability
authors: Anass Grini; Oumaima Taheri; Btissam El Khamlichi; Amal El Fallah-Seghrouchni
venue: 21st International Conference on Distributed Computing in Smart Systems and the Internet of Things (DCOSS-IoT 2025)
notes: arXiv version (2505.01328v1, 6 pages); check equivalence with published version. Venue found via Crossref (IEEE DCOSS-IoT 2025); arXiv page lists no venue. Up to 80.3% of standard adversarial examples violate IoT/NIDS domain constraints (feature-space validity).

title: Test-Time Poisoning Attacks Against Test-Time Adaptation Models
authors: Tianshuo Cong; Xinlei He; Yun Shen; Yang Zhang
venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P 2024)
notes: arXiv version (header 'To Appear in the 45th IEEE S&P 2024'); check equivalence with published version. Generic vision TTA (TTT, DUA, TENT, RPL), not NIDS; key evidence that test-time adaptation loops are poisonable by test-time inputs. Appendix A referenced.

title: Persistent Backdoor Attacks in Continual Learning
authors: Zhen Guo; Abhinav Kumar; Reza Tourani
notes: Confirmed on USENIX proceedings PDF. Blind-task and latent-task backdoors persisting through continual updates; vision-style data, not network traffic. Contains appendix.

title: Entente: Cross-silo Intrusion Detection on Network Log Graphs with Federated Learning
authors: Jiacen Xu; Chenang Li; Yu Zheng; Zhou Li
notes: Confirmed on NDSS PDF title page (also arXiv 2503.14284). Federated graph NIDS (LANL, OpTC, Pivoting); evaluates FL poisoning attacks tailored to GNIDS and bounds attack success via adaptive contribution scaling. NDSS DOI not looked up.

title: The Impact of Active Learning on Availability Data Poisoning for Android Malware Classifiers
authors: Shae McFadden; Zeliang Kan; Lorenzo Cavallaro; Fabio Pierazzi
venue: 2024 Annual Computer Security Applications Conference Workshops (ACSAC Workshops; ARTMAN 2024)
notes: Author-accepted version from UCL Discovery; check equivalence with IEEE published version (IEEE Xplore copy paywalled). Crossref confirms ACSAC Workshops 2024, pp. 73-84. Android malware (not NIDS) but directly studies passive recovery of poisoned models through active-learning retraining under drift. Extends CCS 2023 poster RPAL.

title: A Context Is Worth a Thousand Lies: Evading Intrusion Detectors via Intelligent Context Distortion
authors: Magdy Nasr; Vansh Rastogi; Azadeh Tabiban
venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P 2026)
notes: Author PDF; check equivalence with published version. Title/authors confirmed on S&P 2026 accepted-papers list and Crossref. Attack name Contorter. Evasion of node-level provenance-based IDS (host, not network flows); context-distortion as adaptive attack on graph IDS. Has appendices.

authors: Mehrdad Hajizadeh; Pegah Golchin; Ehsan Nowroozi; Maria Rigaki; Veronica Valeros; Sebastian Garcia; Mauro Conti; Thomas Bauschert
venue: 19th USENIX WOOT Conference on Offensive Technologies (WOOT 2025)
notes: The 'DeepRed' item from the external report. Identity confirmed on USENIX WOOT '25 proceedings PDF title page (Aug 11-12 2025, Seattle).
